name: Towada (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Towada city emblem in blue and green: a disc divided blue above and green below by a wavy line.
history: Municipal flag of Towada, a city in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 14 March 2005.

features.role: Towada city emblem — a disc divided blue above and green below by a wavy line
